scope: Current public CTT postcode definition, search help and search contract, national address database/postal GIS licensing and address-treatment pages plus CTT terms index, DGT authority FAQ and DGT open-data/current-collection descriptions were audited without contacting a provider, registering, authenticating, accepting terms, purchasing data, submitting an address or P.O.-box lookup, querying personal/private property/customer/shipment rows, or creating a repository or publication destination.

countryIdentity.rule: Portugal retains repository PT. CTT postal, DGT administrative/cadastral and address/door-point identities remain separate and no source region or territory is merged or reassigned.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete CTT NNNN-NNN assignment and exception denominator is usable under explicit reviewed permission for AGID processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public serving, and is reconciled to a fixed authoritative Portugal postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon release. Edition, reference date, provider, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, exclusions and reproducible conversion are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. The real PT API/app normalizes NNNN-NNN, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; P.O.-box, organization, route, point, membership-only and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas and no DGT/CAOP, parish, municipality, cadastral, address, street, door-point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.

officialObservations.finding: CTT says a postcode identifies a geographic area in Portugal and defines a seven-digit numeric part written NNNN-NNN plus a separate postal designation. Format and semantics do not themselves provide the current complete assignment/exception denominator or boundary geometry.

The current public POST search is address-driven, offers reverse lookup from postcode and separately offers P.O.-box postcode lookup. No address or P.O.-box value was submitted. The form is neither a fixed bulk distribution nor an areal geometry artifact.

CTT names its national address database and postal GIS, advertises database licensing and supply of portions of the address database, asks customers to specify geography, detail and a need of at least three years, and offers geographic webservices with optional georeferencing. No compatible open AGID derivation/redistribution/public-serving grant or fixed postcode-area release was established.

CTT describes georeferencing each address to coordinates of its respective door in WGS84 EPSG:4326. That is address-point evidence, not a postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon, and no point was buffered or unioned.
DGT states that CTT is responsible for assigning postcodes, INE is responsible for DTMNFR codes and DGT only uses DTMNFR in CAOP, with no postcode-code creation or other intervention role.

DGT describes CC BY 4.0 reuse for its own open data and lists current OGC API collections for CAOP, continental CRUS, cadastre, COS and OrtoSat. No advertised national postcode-area collection was observed. Administrative, land-use, cadastral and imagery authority cannot be relabelled as postal authority.

rightsAssessment.note: Public help/search availability and a commercial service description are not treated as a licence. DGT CC BY 4.0 covers DGT's declared data, not CTT assignment or postcode-area authority. This is a conservative engineering gate, not a legal opinion.

browserReview.reason: No approved fixed authoritative Portugal postcode-area artifact exists. Public search, DGT/CAOP geometry, address/door points and synthetic fixtures were not staged as a false postal area.

reportPresentation.reason: The exact audit table communicates the decisive controlled-rights, point-versus-area and zero-authoritative-geometry gates more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: Current CTT pages establish the NNNN-NNN format, area semantics and search behavior, but not a fixed complete assignment/exception artifact or a compatible AGID reuse grant. CTT describes the national address database/postal GIS through database licensing and geographic webservices; the geometry explicitly described for address treatment is a door Point in EPSG:4326, not a postcode area. DGT explicitly separates postcode assignment authority from DGT/CAOP and no current advertised national postcode-area collection was observed. No fixed authoritative Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact, digest, topology/coverage audit, complete assignment-to-area/non-area reconciliation or real PT runtime/API/UI artifact was established.

Obtain a fixed authoritative Portugal postcode-area Polygon/MultiPolygon release and pin provider, edition, reference date, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, coverage and exclusions.

Build an approved immutable artifact and pass real PT loader, API, NNNN-NNN normalization, geometry validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
